(Criminal side)
 *********
 COMMON ORDER

These two criminal original petitions have been filed by the Nominee of the Company, which is prosecuted for offences under Sections 7(ii), 16(1)(a)(i) and 2(ix)(k) of "the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954" [hereinafter "Act"].

2. The case of the prosecution is that on the date of inspection, samples of coffee powder were collected and sent to forensic laboratory and the same has been tested and opined as adulterated and misbranded, hence prosecution.
3. The petitioner herein, contending that he is not a Nominee of the accused-company and could not be prosecuted, has come before this Court to quash the final report.
According to the petitioner, he was only a sales representative in the accused-company till 15.01.2015.

Earlier, he was https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Crl.O.P.Nos.5880 and 6386 of 2019 appointed as Nominee of the company for the purpose of food adulteration under the Act but however, he was replaced by one V.Sukumaran on 11.11.2008.
Thereafter, V.Sukumaran was replaced by one K.S.Suresh on 16.10.2009 and therefore, the present Nominee has to be prosecuted and not erstwhile Nominee.

4. However, the counter filed by the respondent indicates that the surprise check was conducted by the food safety officers prior to 11.11.2008, particularly in C.C.No.7 of 2010, the subject check was conducted on 24.09.2008 at 01:00 p.m., and in C.C.No.324 of 2009, the subject check was conducted on 09.01.2008.
Both the cases pertain to the manufacturing and possession of adulterated and misbranded food item, by the company, for which the petitioner was the Nominee.

5. Considering the facts, as admitted by the petitioner, he had been relived from the Nominee of the company only on 11.11.2008 whereas, check of the product was commenced much prior to the relieving date and hence he, as a Nominee, is liable to face the prosecution.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Crl.O.P.Nos.5880 and 6386 of 2019 6.
In view of the above fact, both the petitions to quash are dismissed.
Consequently, connected miscellaneous petitions are also closed.
